svg.title: Miniature pig
svg.desc: Young miniature pig in a natural standing view with cloven hooves, short snout, triangular ears, sparse pink skin hair, and a curled tail. Biological basis: Miniature pigs are large-animal models whose cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, dermal, and organ dimensions can support translational physiology and device studies.
